EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a strong carbonyl band at 1686 cm⁻¹ consistent with a conjugated aldehyde C=O, intense aromatic ring bands at 1600 and 1509 cm⁻¹, and aromatic C–H stretches at 3081/3014 cm⁻¹ with aliphatic CH at 2930 cm⁻¹ (consistent with GFQ-003). The pair of strong bands at 1159 and 1268 cm⁻¹ are characteristic of sulfonyl (SO₂) symmetric/asymmetric stretches found in sulfonamides, and the absence of any N–H stretch supports an N,N-dimethyl sulfonamide. The strong 822/839 cm⁻¹ features match out-of-plane aromatic C–H modes of a tri-substituted ring, and the 636 cm⁻¹ band aligns with an aryl C–Br stretch. These combined features best fit CN(C)S(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C=O)c(Br)c1.
